actions.label: Ask for Image Resizer reproduction details

comment.body: Thanks for attaching the bug-report ZIP. Could you add the exact Image Resizer steps too: how you launch it (Explorer context menu, drag/drop, etc.), the file type you test with, which preset or custom size you choose, and what happens after you click Resize? Please also say whether the Image Resizer context-menu entry appears at all and whether you see any visible error dialog or output file.

judgment.rationale: The attached ZIP may contain logs, but the issue body still omits the concrete Image Resizer interaction, selected settings, file type, expected result, and actual failure.
evidence: The issue body lists only a PowerToysReport ZIP under Steps to reproduce and leaves Expected Behavior, Actual Behavior, Additional Information, and Other Software blank.
The live issue has no comments, assignees, or linked PRs/issues that would narrow the failing Image Resizer code path.
